name: Linda Raschke Holy Grail ADX pullback
instruments_timeframes: Source scope as stated; where absent, not specified.

entry_long: ADX(14)>30; after price is above EMA(20), wait for a bar to retrace/touch EMA(20), then place a buy stop above that bar high. Long setup only is described.
